description: This file defines interfaces and data classes related to the Orleans reminder table system, including the IReminderTable interface for storage implementations, ReminderTableData and ReminderEntry classes for representing reminder data, and internal classes for internal use within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ReminderTableData
classes.description: Represents a collection of reminder entries, with constructors for different initialization scenarios.

classes.name: ReminderEntry
classes.description: Represents a single reminder table entry, including grain ID, reminder name, start time, period, and ETag.

classes.name: ReminderData
classes.description: Immutable class implementing IGrainReminder, used internally to represent reminder data.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table asynchronously, delegating to Init() (obsolete).

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Obsolete method for initialization, returns a completed task.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries associated with a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a specified hash range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry by grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry, returning the new ETag.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder entry identified by grain ID, reminder name, and ETag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table, intended for testing purposes.
